'''The Caller in the Dark''' was a creature of an unknown origin that was found under the surface of [[Makeb]], near the location of an ancient abomination [[Gethul]]. Gethul was able to exert mind-control over both sentient individuals and non-sentient creatures, as demonstrated when a team led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adelade]] uncovered it in [[3629 BBY]]. Though not yet fully awake, Adelade and her followers heard Gethul's "song" and fell under its sway, forming a [[Cult of Gethul]] and attempting to fully awaken the creature. Learning of this and fearing that in its full power Gethul could destabilize Makeb's core and obliterate the planet, [[Eternal Alliance]] military Admiral [[Bey'wan Aygo]] sent a strike team to stop Adelade's plan. After confronting and killing Chief Engineer [[Penzaren]], the team approached and engaged The Caller in the Dark, eventually killing it and somewhat lessening the mental toll on their minds.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Caller in the Dark appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a bonus boss during the "Destroyer Of Worlds" Uprising.
